bill.constitutionalAuthorityStatementText:
[Congressional Record Volume 171, Number 1 (Friday, January 3, 2025)]
[House]
From the Congressional Record Online through the Government Publishing Office [www.gpo.gov]
By Ms. VELAZQUEZ:
H.R. 206.
Congress has the power to enact this legislation pursuant
to the following:
Article I, Section 8, Clause 1
The Congress shall have Power to . . . provide for the . .
. general Welfare of the United States; . . .
The single subject of this legislation is:
This bill pertains to the operations and oversight of the
Department of Housing and Urban Development's Section 8
Program.
[Page H43]

latestAction.text: Referred to the Committee on Financial Services, and in addition to the Committees on Ways and Means, and the Judiciary, for a period to be subsequently determined by the Speaker, in each case for consideration of such provisions as fall within the jurisdiction of the committee concerned.
